nom: KORRES Mineral Milk Fluid Sunscreen SPF 50

avis.titre: Broke me out and doesnt blend
avis.texte: This broke me out, and it also doesn't blend. It left white spots on your face!
This is the best replacement I've been able to find for Tula's Mineral Magic. It's hydrating without looking or feeling greasy or sticky, and doesn't leave a white cast.
SO excited i found this product right before summer starts, obsessed with this!!

Obsessed with this sunscreen/skincare POWERHOUSE! Feels like I'm actually taking care of my skin by protecting AND good skincare all packed into one. I use this in the mornings for my no makeup or minimal makeup looks and I swear it leaves my skin hydrated and glass-skin nourished! Many sunscreens break me out or leave me greasy (ew) but this one is wonderful, simple and cares for my skin. 10/10 for a dehydrated skin girlie like me

So happy this product finally launched in the US!! I have bought it abroad and love it so much. It doesn't leave your skin feeling oily and melts right into your skin without any white cast. 10/10 would recommend!!
I was lucky enough to get my hands on this product recently and I cannot say enough good things! It melts into the skin without feeling heavy or pore-clogging. Makes me excited for summer!
This is a very light weight 100% mineral sunscreen. Butyloctyl Salicylate is a liquid that improves spreadablility, boosts sunscreen perfrormance, softens skin and is non greasy.

avis.titre: the only sunscreen I've ever liked
avis.texte: I avoid wearing sunscreen daily because I hate how it feels. this is the first sunscreen i'm happy to put on daily - it blends in well and wears so well with makeup. it makes me feel hydrated and glowy. i also wore it on a boat day and it protects well!
